title: festuca violacea subsp. aurata
intro: Festuca violacea subsp. aurata, commonly known as Gold Dew Fescue, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gold Dew Fescue are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and potentially lower blood pressure. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
